1	# Settings receipts
2	
3	The UI needs trustworthy save confirmation. Client and provider are independently
4	released. Every merged client increment must support the current provider in
5	provider.py, including when enhanced_settings is false. Ordinary saves must keep
6	returning success after values are applied. The provider receipt is a later task.
7	This independent-delivery guarantee is a hard acceptance requirement.
